source:
Tony from childhood dreamed of becoming a racer and achieving a world championship.
After long and hard training, he manages to gain popularity and authority among influential people.
And now, when there is just a little bit left to the pinnacle of glory, terrible events happen to him that change his life forever.
As a result, Tony finds himself in a cycle of events, in which almost all the structures of a small and very developed city,
called Sunset Sity are involved. Now the main character is faced with questions of money, power and even his own life.​

[From F95zone]
translation:
托尼从小就梦想成为一名赛车手并获得世界冠军。
经过长期艰苦的训练，他在有影响力的人物中赢得了知名度和权威。
现在，当他的荣耀只剩下一点点时，可怕的事件发生在他身上，永远改变了他的生活。
结果，托尼发现自己陷入了一个事件的循环中，其中一个小而非常发达的城市的几乎所有结构，
被称为日落城的都参与其中。现在主角面临着金钱、权力甚至自己生命的问题。​

[来自F95zone]
